Responsive breakpoints use the browser viewport rather than the demo card width; widening the card alone does not activate a breakpoint. `span: 0` hides a column, and a matching larger breakpoint can restore it.
父级可通过 `expand-icon` 插槽下发默认展开图标，作用域为 `exp: The parent `expand-icon` slot is forwarded to items that do not provide their own icon. Scope: `expanded`, `disabled`, `position`. It is not rendered on the root node.
确认与取消按钮默认使用 Button 的 `default` 状态和 `text: Confirm and cancel buttons use Button's `default` status and `text` variant unless `confirmButtonProps` or `cancelButtonProps` overrides them.
遮罩通过 Dialog 组件变量消费 `sys-color-scrim`；Map: The backdrop consumes `sys-color-scrim` through the Dialog component variable. Dialog uses its own backdrop variables. Set a per-instance backdrop variable via `overlay-style`; a variable on the panel (`dialog-style`) does not inherit to its sibling backdrop. Explicit `overlay-style.backgroundColor` wins. Teleported content needs variables on its actual DOM ancestors. Dark themes inherit the same semantic colors; geometry remains platform-specific. Status icons use readable content colors.
`inset` 设置沿分割线方向的两端缩进，`spacing` 设置分割线与相邻: `inset` controls the ends of the line; `spacing` controls the outer gap between the line and adjacent content. Both accept presets `xs`, `sm`, `md`, `lg`, `xl`, a number in px, a CSS length, or an array. A scalar or single-item array applies to both ends; `[start, end]` sets each end separately. Array entries are lengths, not preset names.
`inset` 默认不缩进；`spacing` 默认使用当前平台的 `md` 间: `inset` has no inset by default; `spacing` defaults to the platform’s `md` spacing. Presets use platform theme tokens, so pixel values may differ.
图片预览组使用 `v-model` 绑定从 1 开始的图片序号，`default: ImagePreviewGroup binds a one-based image number through ordinary `v-model`; `defaultValue` initializes the uncontrolled index. Panel opening uses `v-model:open` and `defaultOpen` independently. Programmatic preview options also use modelValue/`defaultValue` and onUpdate:modelValue.
命令式预览被新的调用替换时，会清理旧实例并触发旧实例的 `onClosed`；与: Replacing an imperative preview disposes the previous instance and invokes its `onClosed` once, just like normal closure. Use this callback to release owned resources such as Object URLs. Old handles never close newer previews. If `onClosed` synchronously opens a new preview, that newer call wins and the interrupted outer call returns `undefined`.
渲染上下文为 `{ option, active, level }`。`type: The render context is `{ option, active, level }`. `type: 'group'` is visual only and does not add a level; `type: 'divider'` is neither focusable nor activatable.
`update:open`、`open`、`opened`、`close`、`c: `update:open`, `open`, `opened`, `close`, and `closed`, emitted once per visibility cycle.
`transition-duration` 控制 hover/颜色过渡，`sca: `transition-duration` controls hover/color transitions, `scale-duration` controls selection animation, and `transition-timing-function` controls easing. Reduced motion disables these animations. `size` and `gap` props override the corresponding tokens for a single instance.
输入事件约定：编辑时先 `input`、再 `update:modelValue: Input event contract: editing emits `input` before `update:modelValue`; committing on blur emits `change` only for a changed value. Clearing emits `clear → input → update:modelValue → change` once, updates the search field model once, and does not submit a search.
输入编辑发出 `input → update:modelValue`；提交值变化: Editing emits `input → update:modelValue`; changed commits emit `change`. Clear emits `clear → input → update:modelValue → change` once. Disabled, readonly and loading block search, cancel, history and field actions. Form / FormItem / InputGroup state is inherited. Deactivation or unmount cancels pending asynchronous search.
双方控制器、公开 API 和历史内容独立同源。两端默认 `presentatio: The controller, public API and history content are independently copied. Both default to `presentation=inline`; Cedar defaults to `shape=square` and Maple to `shape=round`. Fullscreen history uses local Drawer / Popup instances. Desktop InputGroup and mobile search-bar layout/touch spacing remain independent. Input supports `xs/sm/md/lg/xl`; outer bar density is configured by Search tokens rather than scaled by size.
显式支持 `modelModifiers`、`type`、`ariaLabel`: Explicit Input props include `modelModifiers`, `type`, `ariaLabel`, `placeholder`, `maxLength`, `readonly`, `disabled`, `autofocus`, `enterkeyhint`, `textColor`, `focusColor`, `blurColor`, `size`, `variant`, `clearable`, `inputAttrs` and `error`. `inputAttrs` carries native name/autocomplete/ARIA attributes to both outer and fullscreen Input; `error` overrides inherited error state. Search actions, popup cancellation and dialog labels follow the global locale. Programmatic cancel, field and history selection notify Form change once; native edits retain the Input event pipeline.
`SelectValue` 包含 `undefined`。默认单选清空发出 `': `SelectValue` includes `undefined`. By default, single-select clear emits `''`; if the current options contain a `value: ''` option, it emits `undefined` to distinguish clearing from selecting that option. This published behavior is preserved. Both `change` and `update:modelValue` use `SelectValue`.
根入口与组件入口均导出 `SelectValue`、`SelectEmptyVa: Root and component entries export `SelectValue` and `SelectEmptyValue`.
Select 还支持 `header`、`footer`、`trigger` 和: Select additionally supports `header`, `footer`, `trigger`, and default `Option / Optgroup` children. Option props: `value`, `label`, `disabled`, `tagProps`, `index`; its default slot receives `selected`. Group data uses `{ isGroup: true, label, options }`. List and Picker also accept slot options; Picker displays their text labels.
根入口和组件入口均导出 `SelectEmits`、`SelectSlots`、: Root and component entries export `SelectEmits`、`SelectSlots`、`SelectExpose` alongside Props and Instance. Emits are event argument tuples derived from the runtime validators; Expose contains focus/blur.
守卫统一使用 `(payload, done, context)`：关闭 pay: Cancellable hooks use `(payload, done, context)`: closure payloads contain `{ action }`, change/commit payloads contain `{ value, previousValue }`, and Popup uses `{ reason }`. Context provides `signal` and an optional original `event`. Return a boolean/Promise, or call done()/done(false). Synchronous void waits for done; Promise<void> allows the operation. First completion wins. Pending state controls loading/disabled automatically. Cancellation invalidates stale results. Button refs are not exposed.
省略 `disabled` / `readonly` 时依次继承 FormIte: Omitted `disabled` / `readonly` inherit FormItem, then Form; an explicit `false` overrides inherited state. Becoming disabled or read-only invalidates a pending `beforeChange`, so a late result cannot toggle the value. Outside a form, omitted values behave as false.
原生方法：`focus(options?: FocusOptions)`、`bl: Native methods: `focus(options?: FocusOptions)`, `blur()`, `select()`; `textareaRef` is the native element.
`reupload` 默认 false，开启逐项替换。`replace(file: `reupload` (default false) enables a per-item replacement action, including when maxFiles has been reached. `replace(file, replacement?: File): Promise<void>` opens a single-file chooser or validates the supplied File. It respects readonly/disabled and the chooser hook. Validation and beforeRemove run before an atomic in-place replacement proposal with a new UID; count and total size exclude the old item. Cancellation, rejection, guard veto and stale targets preserve the old item. A controlled parent decides acceptance. The `replace(next, previous)` event is a model proposal, not remote success or removal; remove is not emitted. Once accepted, obsolete transport callbacks are ignored; new upload failures can be retried. The item slot also exposes replace().
`swipe-to-close` 默认 false；开启后可以从默认标题向下拖动: For bottom placement, opt in with `swipe-to-close` and mark a noninteractive header with `data-popup-swipe-handle`. `swipe-threshold` defaults to 40 layout CSS px and accounts for ancestor scaling. A sufficient downward gesture requests update:open(false) and emits swipe-close(PointerEvent). Short/upward/horizontal gestures, pointer cancellation, body scrolling and interactive header controls do not dismiss. Controlled refusal keeps the sheet open. Field editors opt in and cancel unconfirmed drafts; pending confirmation disables dismissal. ActionSheet forwards both props; custom title slots must mark their handle.
本组件支持 `presentation`，字段 > FormItem > For: `presentation` inherits from field > FormItem > Form and defaults to `popup`. Supported values are `inline / popup`. Inline keeps the existing control behavior. Overlay editing uses a Cell reference and an isolated draft; only confirmation updates v-model. Cancel, reset and enabling readPretty discard the draft.
文字、汇总数量和按钮式触发图标默认使用主要内容色；描边跟随容器表面；只有深色交互: Text, summary counts, and button-style trigger icons use the primary content role. Borders follow the ordinary container surface; only icons on the dark interaction overlay use `content-on-dark`. The `fill-4` avatar background, trigger background/hover step, and translucent black overlay remain component visual values. If the `color` prop changes the avatar background, check text contrast and override `text-color` when needed. Maple's dark avatar background remains a component-specific `#303030`.
横向内容区独立消费 `--mp-card-content-row-margin`: Row content consumes `--mp-card-content-row-margin`, independently from the title margin. Card intentionally exposes only sm/md density, not all five control sizes. Motion uses `--mp-card-animation-duration` (`var(--mp-sys-motion-duration-slow)`) and `--mp-card-animation-easing` (`var(--mp-sys-motion-easing-standard)`). Reduced motion disables transitions on every animated Card section.
本组件支持 `presentation`，字段 > FormItem > For: `presentation` inherits from field > FormItem > Form and defaults to `inline`. Supported values are `inline / popup`. Inline keeps the existing control behavior. Overlay editing uses a Cell reference and an isolated draft; only confirmation updates v-model. Cancel, reset and enabling readPretty discard the draft.
组件导出以下类型定义。`Collapse.Item` 与 `mp-collaps: `Collapse.Item` is the same component as `mp-collapse-item`; `app.use(Collapse)` registers both.
`date-fields` 与 `time-fields` 分别控制日期、时间滚: `date-fields` and `time-fields` independently control date and time columns and their order. The two groups do not interleave. Fields and standalone panels share the same props; range endpoints share the configuration.
`DateRangePicker.datePickerProps` 与 `Dat: `DateRangePicker.datePickerProps` and `DateRange.datePickerProps` accept only `DateRangeCalendarOptions`: `hint`, `color`, `titleColor`, `buttonElevation`, `touchable`. Model, validation, viewport, presentation, elevation, abbreviation and action control stay at the range root. Unknown keys and event listeners are not forwarded. The calendar branches explicitly use calendar presentation.
公共日期解析器按展示 `format` 严格解析，再以 `value-forma: The copied date parser strictly uses display `format`, serializes through `value-format`, and checks the existing disabled/range rules. Single/range date fields now wire real native input. Editing is enabled by default: input clicks only edit; the calendar button or ArrowDown opens the panel, and Enter/blur commits. Set `input-editable=false` for panel-only selection. Multiple/function-formatted display has no inverse text protocol and stays readonly. A function `format` has no inverse parsing protocol: disable `input-editable` and use the selection panel. Maple has no week/quarter presentation; copied parsing logic does not introduce unsupported component types.
描述使用低强调文字语义，装饰图标使用 `content-decorative`；: Descriptions use low-emphasis text semantics; decorative icons use `content-decorative`, which must not be used for readable text. Custom images or slots may supply their own colors and are not forcibly recolored by `icon-color`. Sizing and spacing may follow mobile density while same-name tokens keep Cedar's responsibilities.
超过 `max-length` 时，`update:model-value` 和: When `max-length` is exceeded, `update:model-value` and `input` emit the truncated value. Clearing emits `clear → input → update:model-value → change` once each; the following blur does not repeat `change`.
内部类名统一为 `mp-link--status-*`、`mp-link--un: Internal classes use `mp-link--status-*`, `mp-link--underline-*` and `mp-link__icon`. Migrate old selectors such as `mp-link--primary`; prefer CSS variables. Existing color/icon/focus variables are retained as aliases for the copied styles.
保留给 SplitButton 和手写 `content` 场景。分组和子菜单只: Kept for SplitButton and hand-written `content`. Groups and submenus are described through `options` only; there are no `MenuGroup` or `MenuSubmenu` components.
`click` 事件在未禁用时触发；`default`、`icon`、`suff: `click` fires when the option is not disabled. The `default`, `icon` and `suffix` slots and the `label` render function receive the same `{ option, active, level }` context.
键盘面板独立使用 `open/defaultOpen` 与 `update:op: The keyboard panel uses an independent `open/defaultOpen` model with `update:open`. Text and panel opening are separate states.
`--mp-page-header-back-hover-size`（30px）: `--mp-page-header-back-hover-size` (30px) controls the feedback circle without moving the title; `--mp-page-header-back-hover-bg` (`var(--mp-sys-color-state-hover)`) supplies its background. Hover feedback only applies to fine pointers supporting hover; keyboard focus-visible remains available for all input modes.
触发元素通过 `aria-controls`、`aria-expanded` 与: The reference is connected to the panel with `aria-controls` and `aria-expanded`. Use Trigger for unstyled positioning. Popover has no `defaultStyle`, `popoverClass`, or `elevation`; customize with tokens, `content-class`, or `content-style`.
组件同时导出 `SkeletonLine` 和 `SkeletonShape`，: The package also exports `SkeletonLine` and `SkeletonShape`, available as `Skeleton.Line` and `Skeleton.Shape` for custom templates.
设置 `auto-loading`，让 `@click` 回调返回 Promis: With `auto-loading`, return a Promise from `@click`. Both `@click` and `button-props.onClick` run once; the primary button waits for all returned Promises to settle. Synchronous callbacks do not flash a loading state. Like Button, click is an onClick callback prop that consumes return values, not a second emitted notification. Primary clicks bubble normally and never open the menu. Overall disabled takes priority over either button configuration.
未传 `z-index` 时消费 `--mp-tab-bar-z-index`，: When `z-index` is omitted, the component consumes `--mp-tab-bar-z-index`. An explicit number or CSS string takes precedence. The default visual stacking level is `1`.
完整公开变量以 `style/token.less` 中的 `--mp-tag-: The complete public contract is the `--mp-tag-*` set in `style/token.less`. Customize it with [ThemeProvider](#/en-US/theme-provider). Cedar uses the same logical names with a different brand prefix.
在 Form/FormItem 内未显式设置时，`size`、`disabled: Inside Form/FormItem, omitted `size`, `disabled`, `readonly`, and `error` inherit form state. Explicit local values, including `false`, take precedence.
`popup-props` 配置锚定字段的 Trigger popover 定位: `popup-props` configures the anchored Trigger popover on both platforms. It cannot replace field open/disabled/trigger ownership. Top-level popup-container, including false, takes precedence. Panel and popup options are separate. `click(event)` fires once for an enabled field; readonly fields notify but do not open. Use `open-change(false)` for close requests, not proof that a controlled state changed. The field close event has been removed without an alias.
`placeholder` 支持 `string | string[]`：字符串: Range `placeholder` accepts `string | string[]`: a string labels both endpoints; array entries label each endpoint, with missing entries empty. Explicit empty strings do not fall back to defaults.
内容具有 `role=\"tooltip\"`，打开时通过 `aria-desc: The content has `role="tooltip"` and is connected to the actual reference with `aria-describedby`. Cedar and Maple keep independent copies of the same implementation; there are no `backgroundColor` or boolean `xs` compatibility aliases.
交互延迟和关闭策略还包括 `mouse-enter-delay`、`mouse-: Interaction timing and dismissal props also include `mouse-enter-delay`, `mouse-leave-delay`, `focus-delay`, `popup-hover-stay`, `blur-to-close`, `close-on-click-reference`, `click-outside-to-close`, `esc-to-close`, and `restore-focus`.
比较标题层级、内容居中与通栏布局。通栏用于页面级提示；操作和关闭能力另见后续示例: Compare title hierarchy, centered content and page-wide banners. Actions and dismiss behavior have separate examples.
分别操作默认与自定义关闭入口，比较相同关闭能力的呈现方式。: Operate the default and custom dismiss controls to compare the same dismissal behavior.
先比较相同内容在各尺寸下的占位，再比较圆形和方形边界；图片适配与错误回退保持独立: Compare space used at each size, then round and square boundaries. Image fitting and fallback remain separate.
比较横向和纵向头像组，观察最大数量、重叠顺序和溢出提示。: Compare horizontal and vertical groups, maximum counts, stacking and overflow indicators.
对比指示器类型和位置；切换轮播页后观察活动指示器，导航箭头和自定义指示器另行展示: Compare indicator types and positions, then change slides to observe the active indicator.
在各预览中切换相邻项，比较淡入淡出、卡片与滑动效果；自动播放和输入方式不混入效果: Change adjacent slides to compare fade, card and slide effects independently of autoplay and input methods.
比较子组件声明和 options 数据声明；两种方式都使用组值，字段映射和异步选: Compare child-component declarations with options data. Both use a group model; field mapping and asynchronous data are separate.
比较外边框和面板间分隔线，分别展开面板观察两种装饰的边界。: Compare outer borders and separators between panels, including their appearance while expanded.
比较小数精度对最终文本的影响，以及时长和缓动曲线对数字变化过程的影响；手动启动、: Compare final precision and the effect of duration and easing on number transitions. Manual playback remains separate.
比较单位格式、毫秒显示和自定义时间片段。使用各示例中的时间字段检查最终文本，而非: Compare unit formats, milliseconds and custom time fragments, independently of playback controls.
分别打开弹窗，比较宽度、全屏或长内容的可视范围；关闭当前弹窗后再打开另一种布局。: Open one dialog at a time to compare widths, fullscreen layouts and long-content boundaries.
比较线宽/缩进、线型和颜色；带文字与自定义内容保持独立，避免把插槽行为混入线条装: Compare thickness or insets, line style and color. Text and custom content remain separate.
依次打开不同抽屉，比较方向和占用空间；嵌套、挂载容器与关闭拦截另见后续案例。: Open each drawer separately to compare placement and occupied space. Nesting, containers and guards remain separate.
对比自定义图形和补充操作，观察替换默认内容与保留业务操作入口的区别。: Compare custom artwork and extra actions to distinguish content replacement from supplemental controls.
比较自动测量、栅格分配和固定标签宽度。用长短标签观察输入区域对齐；标签方向和校验: Compare measured, grid-based and fixed label widths with different label lengths. Orientation and validation remain separate.
比较相同图标的尺寸和颜色，旋转/动画与点击行为另行展示。: Compare size and color independently of rotation, animation and click handling.
比较图片说明和附加插槽的位置；预览入口、加载和错误回退保持独立。: Compare caption and extra-slot placement independently of previews, loading and failures.
比较尺寸和禁用/只读/错误外观，操作可编辑实例观察标签布局；空值协议保持独立。: Compare sizes and disabled, read-only or error appearance while keeping the empty-value protocol separate.
比较尺寸和语义颜色；导航目标、禁用拦截和加载反馈保留独立行为示例。: Compare sizes and semantic colors independently of navigation, disabled interception and loading.
对比相同加载状态的图形、尺寸和颜色；容器遮罩与指令用法保持独立。: Compare the shape, size and color of loading indicators. Container masks and directives remain separate.
比较平级分组、层级菜单和自定义选项内容。展开子菜单或选择选项，观察各自的数据层级: Compare flat groups, nested menus and option content. Expand or select options to inspect their hierarchy.
比较面包屑导航和透明背景下的标题层级；完整业务内容另见独立案例。: Compare breadcrumb navigation and title hierarchy on transparent surfaces.
比较三种分页附加能力。更改页码或每页条数时观察对应输出，数据总数与自动修正另行说: Compare total labels, page-size selection and page jumpers. Change the available controls and observe their output.
在相同进度范围内比较尺寸和状态色；环形、分段和不确定进度保留独立模型。: Compare sizes and semantic states independently of circular, stepped and indeterminate models.
比较同类分段数据的尺寸和颜色覆盖；方向、环形布局、总量溢出与键盘操作另行展示。: Compare segment sizes and color overrides separately from orientation, circular layouts, overflow and keyboard interaction.
比较子项与 options 声明，选择不同项观察组值；自定义字段与异步数据仍单独: Compare child and options declarations, then select items to inspect the group model.
比较评分上限和重复选择时的清除行为；半星精度、键盘输入与受控值保持独立。: Compare rating totals and clearing the current selection, separately from half steps, keyboards and controlled values.
对比语义状态如何影响图形、标题和操作区；HTTP 状态与自定义图形另行展示。: Compare how semantic states affect the icon, title and actions. HTTP statuses and custom artwork remain separate.
比较无权限、资源不存在和服务器错误的内容层级，按业务恢复路径选择操作文案。: Compare permission, missing-resource and server-error content, with recovery actions appropriate to each case.
比较不同尺寸的密度与禁用选项的行为；受控值和块级布局保持独立。: Compare density at each size and disabled-option behavior.
比较标题/文本行与头像/卡片形态，按最终内容轮廓选择占位布局；动画和全屏加载另行: Compare text-row placeholders with avatar and card shapes according to the final content layout.
比较排列方向、顺序与标签位置；待完成状态和自定义节点不与布局混合。: Compare orientation, sequence and label placement independently of pending states and custom nodes.
比较节点尺寸、整行占位和连接线；选择策略、拖拽与异步子节点保持独立。: Compare node sizes, full-row blocks and connecting lines separately from selection, dragging and asynchronous nodes.
比较单元格的前置图标、补充描述和列表分隔，按信息层级选择组合。: Compare leading icons, supplementary descriptions and row separators according to information hierarchy.
比较边框、完全圆角和指定半径；动态属性与点击波纹另行展示。: Compare borders, fully rounded corners and explicit radii independently of live updates and ripple interaction.
依次触发浮层，对比锚点方向、偏移与触发器宽度适配。关闭当前浮层后比较下一种配置。: Open popovers one at a time to compare placement, offsets and trigger-width fitting.
比较水印重复间距、起始偏移和旋转角度；图片加载与全屏定位保持独立。: Compare repetition gaps, origin offsets and rotation independently of image loading and fullscreen positioning.
比较靠右、居中和两端分布；保持相同内容数量时观察剩余空间如何分配。: Compare end, center and space-between alignment while observing how remaining space is allocated.
分别点击当前项和其他项，对比点击通知与值变更通知；受控和非受控值模型另行展示。: Click the current and a different item to distinguish click notifications from value changes.
拖动滑块对比自定义按钮和数值标签；步长、双滑块与键盘模型保留独立场景。: Drag the sliders to compare custom thumbs and value labels independently of steps, ranges and keyboard models.
分别滚动三个有边框的区域，比较顶部/底部吸附和不同偏移；每个预览独立指定滚动容器: Scroll each bordered area separately to compare top/bottom affixing and offsets within an explicit scroll container.
比较分钟、秒和十二小时显示；注意午夜 12 AM 与中午 12 PM 的区别。值: Compare minute, second and 12-hour displays. Distinguish midnight (12 AM) from noon (12 PM); model formats and step constraints remain separate.
比较范围的分钟、秒与十二小时制显示，操作起止端点观察格式；跨日判断和值格式独立展: Compare minute, second and 12-hour range displays and edit both endpoints. Next-day rules and model formats remain separate.
对照工作日规则与指定日期覆盖；在允许和禁止的时段分别尝试创建或编辑任务，观察完整: Compare recurring hours with date-specific overrides. Attempt creation or editing inside and outside available periods to inspect full-duration validation.
分别选择超出大小和数量限制的本地文件，观察拒绝反馈；选择限制与请求前处理、上传队: Choose local files exceeding the size or count limits and inspect the rejection feedback. Selection limits are separate from request preparation and upload queues.

`change` 只通知固定状态变化：已固定时重复测量不重复发送 true，禁用: `change` only reports transitions in fixed state: repeated measurements while fixed do not repeat true, and disabling releases fixation with false and 0. 轴线和高亮位于阅读起点，链接缩进使用逻辑位置，纵向滚动和锚点目标保持不变。: The axis and highlight sit at inline start; link indentation uses logical positioning. Vertical scrolling and anchor targets are unchanged.

根元素默认 `role=\"group\"`；使用 `aria-label` 或: The root defaults to `role="group"`. Supply `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby` when the action group needs a name. Native attributes can override role. Ordinary groups retain native Tab / Enter / Space handling without arrow-key focus management.

无自定义事件。`@click` 是根元素的原生事件透传，可以接收后代冒泡；各操作: No custom events. `@click` forwards a native root event and may receive descendant bubbling; listen to each Button's click for its action. The group does not collect event Promises or manage tasks or selection.

**组合边界：** 额外的 DOM 包装层、前后文本和其他控件不属于连体外观契约: **Composition:** extra DOM wrappers, surrounding text and other controls are outside the joined appearance contract. 响应式组配置对象，各字段为只读 ComputedRef；elevation 为: Reactive group configuration with readonly ComputedRef fields; elevation is boolean / number and other fields match the Props
标题、内容和操作沿阅读顺序排列，默认浮动操作位于阅读终点，不镜像图片或自定义插槽: Title, content and actions follow reading order. Default floating actions sit at inline end; images and custom slots are not mirrored.
根节点的 `keydown`、`mouseenter`、`mouseleave`: Native root listeners such as `keydown`, `mouseenter`, `mouseleave`, `focusin` and `focusout` run alongside internal navigation and autoplay pause handling. Native `.once` listeners fire once for the root element lifetime.
文字对齐 left / center / right；未设置时继承 FormIt: Physical text alignment: left / center / right. When omitted, inherits FormItem content-align; standalone fields default to logical start
字段和独立 Panel 的 `loadMore(option, done)` 均: `loadMore(option, done)` keeps a callback-only contract in the field and standalone panel. Call `done(children)` to accept children or `done()` to end waiting and allow retry. Only the first callback is accepted; return values, including a resolved Promise, do not replace `done`. A synchronous loader exception releases waiting and reaches Vue's `errorCaptured` / application `errorHandler`. The `load-error` event remains specific to the `options` data source; it does not report `loadMore` exceptions. Handle asynchronous callback-based request failures in business code and call `done()`.
替换选项（包括嵌套原地修改）、字段映射或加载函数会使旧请求和懒加载缓存失效。卸载: Replacing options, including nested mutations, field mappings or the loader invalidates old requests and cached lazy children. Unmounting or deactivation invalidates pending callbacks; stale results cannot modify replacement nodes or clear a newer request's pending state.
继承最近的 `dir=\"ltr|rtl\"`，支持运行时切换与局部覆盖。标题文: Inherits the nearest `dir="ltr|rtl"`, including runtime changes and local overrides. Header and expanded content inherit reading direction; changing direction preserves expansion. expand-icon-position left/right remain physical sides. Custom expansion graphics are not mirrored automatically.
拖动监听绑定控件所属视图。KeepAlive 停用或卸载会结束当前手势并释放监听: Drag listeners belong to the control's own view. KeepAlive deactivation or unmount ends the current gesture and releases listeners. Reactivation requires a new gesture; callbacks from the old gesture cannot change values.
时长为有限非负毫秒数。0 在下一帧到达目标；负数、NaN 和无穷值会产生开发环境: Duration is a finite nonnegative number of milliseconds. Zero reaches the target on the next frame. Negative, NaN and infinite values produce development prop diagnostics and safely behave as zero without continuing to request animation frames. Pausing or unmounting before that frame cancels completion. String durations retain parseFloat conversion. reset reads auto-start again. end remains a notification; its listener Promise is not awaited.
组件继承最近的 `dir=\"ltr|rtl\"`，支持运行时切换与局部方向覆盖: Inherits the nearest `dir="ltr|rtl"`, including runtime changes and local overrides. Calendar dates, months and years follow reading order; navigation icons mirror, while date values keep their meaning. In paged grids, Left/Right moves focus visually, Up/Down moves one row, and Home/End moves to the row boundary, skipping disabled items. Explicit `shortcuts-position="left|right"` remains physical; `bottom` stays below. Field popovers inherit their source direction.
范围值始终保持 `[开始, 结束]`，切换阅读方向不会交换端点或提交草稿。日历范: Range values remain `[start, end]`; changing reading direction does not swap endpoints or commit drafts. Calendar range connections and boundary radii follow reading direction. In paged grids, Left/Right moves focus visually and Up/Down preserves date-row order. Maple endpoint editing and continuous range highlighting use different rendering paths. Explicit `shortcuts-position="left|right"` remains physical; popovers inherit the field's source direction.
延迟编辑时，清空只改变草稿；确认后先执行表单校验和 `beforeCommit`: In deferred editing, clearing changes the draft; confirmation runs form validation and `beforeCommit` before publishing the configured `emptyValue`. Cancel restores the committed range. An untouched empty range or a half-selected range still requires complete endpoints; an explicit change from a non-empty range to an empty draft can be confirmed. Disabled/readonly fields and locked endpoints cannot be cleared. A rejected controlled open cannot publish a cleared model.
继承最近的 `dir=\"ltr|rtl\"`，支持运行时切换与局部覆盖。标签和: Inherits the nearest `dir="ltr|rtl"`, including runtime changes and local overrides. Labels and values follow reading order, with logical boundaries and default alignment. Changing direction does not reverse records, column definitions or span meanings.
继承最近的 `dir=\"ltr|rtl\"`，支持运行时切换与局部覆盖。内容、: Inherits the nearest `dir="ltr|rtl"`, including runtime changes and local overrides. Content, titles and action spacing use logical start/end. External popovers inherit their source direction. Closing, confirmation, cancellation and uncommitted state are unchanged by direction switches.
before-* 等待期间显示加载反馈并标记 aria-busy；拒绝或失败后恢: Awaited before-* hooks show loading feedback and aria-busy. Rejection or failure restores interaction; repeated input does not start the same operation again. Ordinary event return Promises do not participate in loading.

With approval enabled, holding a button does not start repeated requests. Ordinary listener Promises are not approval tasks.

direct 审批异常通知；非拒绝布尔值: Direct approval error notification; a boolean veto is not an error
原生键盘通知，可同步 preventDefault: Native keyboard notification with synchronous preventDefault support

- focus(index?)：零基索引；省略时定位首个空格，满码定位末格。di: - focus(index?): zero-based index; defaults to the first empty cell or the last cell when full. Direct readonly fields can receive focus. Deferred mode opens an editable panel first; disabled, readonly, or reading fields do not open.

公开方法从组件首次挂载起保持可调用；保存下来的方法每次查找当前编辑器，关闭、重开: Public methods remain callable from initial component mount. Stored methods resolve the current editor on every call and never use an old input after closure, reopening, or mode changes. Native input references are undefined while no editor is mounted.

refresh 可在编辑器未打开时重试组件自有的异步选项读取，沿用既有 Abor: Refresh can retry the component-owned asynchronous option source before the editor opens, using the existing AbortSignal, loading, and load-error protocol without opening the editor; static arrays do not create extra requests.

既有 CascaderEditMode 类型可从组件子入口及根入口导入，与当前平: The existing CascaderEditMode type is exported from both the component subentry and the root entry, matching the edit-mode values supported by the current platform.

Cached and remounted editors both resolve the current target.
focus()/blur() 通过当前 Select 引用操作真实输入；允许编辑: Focus/blur delegate through the current Select reference to the real input. In an editable deferred mode, focus opens the editor first. Disabled, readonly, or reading deferred fields do not open; direct readonly fields remain focusable. is-label has no input and methods do not open an editor. Reopening uses the current target, and disposed methods do not affect other inputs.
公开实例类型 SelectInstance/SelectExpose 与 Peo: Public SelectInstance/SelectExpose and PeopleSelectInstance/PeopleSelectExpose reflect the existing methods. PeopleSelectExpose is available from the root and component subentry. refresh() returns `Promise<void>` and reloads function-based options through the existing protocol; it does not represent completion of saving or business actions.
调用清除动作时触发: Emitted when the clear action is invoked
`before-commit(payload, done, context)`: `before-commit(payload, done, context)` can guard saving the editor. FormItem validates the candidate first; invalid candidates keep the editor open. `open / default-open / update:open` control the editor. `#read="{ value, text }"` customizes read content. See the unified field presentation examples in Form.
`unique-value` 按合并后的 `field-names.value`: `unique-value` compares normalized object and string tag values using the merged `field-names.value` mapping. Numeric `1` and string `"1"` are distinct. 公开 Props 不包含 `baseCls`、`focused`、`disabl: Public Props exclude the internal composition controls `baseCls`, `focused`, `disabledInput` and `uninjectFormItemContext`. Clearing defaults to [], while explicit empty-value=null preserves null.
有限非负整数；0 不限，非法值诊断后按不限展示: Finite nonnegative integer; 0 is unlimited, invalid values diagnose and fall back to unlimited display
业务控制的加载状态，不禁止输入: Business-controlled loading state; does not block input
共享字段反馈形态，不是 Loading 动画类型: Shared field feedback appearance, independent of Loading animation types
清空输出；默认空数组，可显式配置 null: Clear output; defaults to an empty array and accepts explicit null
空值识别策略，字段优先于 FormItem 和 Form: Empty-value recognition; field takes precedence over FormItem and Form
阅读空文案，显式空字符串有效: Read empty text; an explicit empty string is valid
编辑模式；字段优先于 FormItem 和 Form: Editing mode; field takes precedence over FormItem and Form
独立阅读状态，显式 false 覆盖父级: Independent read presentation; explicit false overrides the parent
延迟编辑保存前守卫；返回布尔值、Promise 或通过 done 完成: Guard before saving a deferred edit; return a boolean or Promise, or complete via done
受控编辑层开关，不是内部原生输入焦点: Controlled editor visibility, separate from native input focus
非受控编辑层初始开关: Initial visibility of an uncontrolled editor
标签模型更新提案，确认模式在保存后通知: Tag model update proposal; deferred mode notifies after saving
自定义阅读内容，优先于 empty-text: Custom read content, taking precedence over empty-text
显式 null 是受控空码，不回退到 default-value；默认值仅用于未: Explicit null is a controlled empty code and never falls back to default-value, which applies only when model-value is absent. reset() still proposes an empty string. Presentation clearing can submit null through empty-value=null; finish never receives null. An omitted model-value remains uncontrolled.
延迟模式的 input / paste 仍表示编辑过程；finish 表示最终接: In deferred mode input / paste describe editing, while finish describes the finally accepted complete value. Canceling, rejection, readonly, disabled, external replacement or unmount retires unaccepted completion notifications. Ordinary finish listener Promises do not hold confirmation. A synchronous undefined before-commit return waits for done. Invalid type / align values diagnose and fall back to digit / center; gutter=0 and 0px remain valid.
展示层清空输出，默认空字符串，可显式配置 null: Presentation clear output; defaults to an empty string and accepts explicit null
延迟编辑层清空操作，不改变每格输入: Deferred editor clearing; does not change individual input cells
编辑模式，继承 FormItem 和 Form: Editing mode, inherited from FormItem and Form
direct 在父级本轮接受完整值后通知；延迟模式在确认守卫通过且父级接受后通知: Direct mode notifies after the parent accepts the complete code in the current render; deferred mode waits for confirmation guards and parent acceptance, never draft completion
粘贴从当前格开始覆盖，根元素的粘贴从第 1 格开始；超出首个空格的输入会归到首个: Paste overwrites from the current cell; root-level paste starts at cell 1. Input beyond the first empty cell moves to that first empty cell. A whole-code native input distributes across subsequent cells. SMS suggestions depend on the platform and browser: Cedar hints one-time-code on the first cell, while Maple retains autocomplete=off for all cells. Typing one character in a filled cell replaces that cell even when the caret follows its old character. Composition prefers the current compositionend text, including multiple code points, and falls back to the native value only when event data is missing. Processing is type filtering, formatter, then length clipping; rejected characters consume no cell. Text counts Unicode code points rather than grapheme clusters. External values affect display without an automatic formatted model update.
## 原生输入属性与键盘拦截: ## Native input attributes and keyboard cancellation
`id`、`form`、`required`、其他原生约束、`aria-*`、`: Native id, form, required, constraints, aria/data attributes and keyboard listeners belong to the actual input. Class/style and other shell attributes remain on the label. Generated native IDs are stable and unique, and an external label can target an explicit id. HTML required participates in native browser form validation, separately from Form business rules.
原生监听的 Once / Capture / Passive 修饰符保留在 in: Once / Capture / Passive native listener modifiers stay on the input rather than firing from interactive slot children. Checked, disabled, input type and group Tab navigation remain component-managed.
Checkbox 的 null 模型仍表示空状态；default / check: The nullable Checkbox model is preserved. checked in default / checkbox slots is always boolean, with null shown as false; rendering alone never proposes a new model.

### 参数、展示清空与挂载边界: ### Parameters, presentation clearing and mount-time boundaries
orientation 仅接受 horizontal / vertical，非法: orientation accepts horizontal / vertical and falls back to horizontal after invalid-value diagnostics. max belongs to CheckboxGroup: valid values are finite nonnegative integers, zero forbids new choices, and omission is unlimited. Existing external values are never truncated. Invalid JavaScript callers retain the existing normalization after diagnostics: negatives become zero, fractions are floored, NaN is unlimited, and Infinity remains unlimited.
icon-size 接受正长度，数值和纯数字字符串按 px，允许 0.5 这样的: icon-size accepts positive lengths. Numbers and numeric strings use px, including positive fractions such as 0.5. uninject-group-context 在挂载时决定是否接入分组；运行中修: uninject-group-context decides group participation at mount. Changing it later does not reinject; change the key or remount. An isolated control still participates in Form. clearable / empty-value apply only to explicit presentation-layer clearing; native unchecking still proposes false or removes the array value and never uses empty-value. Ordinary event Promises do not participate in waiting; before-commit uses payload / done / context only when saving a deferred edit.
显式 options 加载期间，两端分组通过 aria-busy 通知等待，失败: During an explicit options request both group roots announce aria-busy and emit one load-error on failure. No loading prop or extra graphic is added, and loading/failure never proposes a new model.
正长度；非法值诊断并回退主题: Positive length; invalid values diagnose and fall back to the theme
延迟编辑层清空操作，不改变原生取消选择: Deferred editor clearing; does not change native deselection
展示层显式清空输出，不控制原生取消勾选: Explicit presentation clear output; does not control native unchecking
显式选项加载失败，不改变模型: Explicit option loading failed; does not change the model
未提供 options 时的原生子选项: Native child options when options is omitted
公开导出类型：`CheckboxOption`、`ChoiceFieldName: Public types: `CheckboxOption`, `ChoiceFieldNames`, `CheckboxSlots` and `CheckboxGroupSlots`, consistently exported from root and subentries.
普通圆形 Radio 的图标不随 Group.size 缩放；size 五档用于: Ordinary circular Radio icons do not scale with Group.size. The five sizes apply to button presentation; circular dimensions use icon-size or the theme. 实例选中颜色；错误和禁用优先: Instance checked color; error and disabled take precedence
原生属性别名，不能覆盖组件管理的状态: Native attribute alias; cannot override component-managed state
挂载时决定是否脱离分组，仍参与 Form: Choose group isolation at mount while retaining Form participation
button 标签或默认圆形标签: Button label or default circular label

prefix 支持单字符、多字符及字符串数组。选择时只替换光标前已匹配的前缀和查: prefix accepts single characters, multiple characters and arrays of strings. Selection replaces only the matched prefix and query before the caret, preserving the trailing text; the textarea mirror uses the matched prefix. Nested data groups render nonselectable titles and only leaves may be selected; disabled leaves do not submit. The option slot receives normalized candidates, including the valid identities zero and empty string.

options 是显式数据加载入口，接收 query 和 { signal }，: options is an explicit data loader accepting query and { signal }; it may return an array or a Promise. value: string \\| null, text: string；保留原: value: string \| null, text: string; preserves the raw empty model

AutoComplete 的文本输入始终可搜索；filter-option 只控: AutoComplete text input always supports searching; filter-option only controls local matching and does not issue requests. 受控文本；null 显示为空: Controlled text; null displays as empty
候选数组或显式加载函数，支持嵌套分组: Candidate array or explicit loader, including nested groups
触发前缀；支持多字符和多个前缀: Trigger prefix; supports multiple characters and multiple prefixes
提及前后的分隔符: Separator before and after a mention
允许清空文本或编辑草稿: Allow clearing text or the editor draft
value: string \\| null；不附带原生 Event: value: string \| null; no native Event argument
value: SelectOptionValue \\| undefined；来: value: SelectOptionValue \| undefined; from the actual leaf candidate
error: unknown；保留加载源原始错误: error: unknown; preserves the original loader error

聚焦当前目标；延迟模式按字段编辑协议打开: Focus the current target; deferred mode follows the field editing protocol
失焦当前目标，不打开编辑器: Blur the current target without opening the editor
重试当前 data 查询，沿用取消与失败协议，不打开编辑器；静态数组不发请求: Retry the current data query with cancellation and failure handling, without opening the editor; static arrays issue no request
两种输入形态的候选内容；data: SelectOptionInfo，含 key: Candidates in both input presentations; data: SelectOptionInfo, including key, raw, value and label
两种输入形态的阅读内容；value: string \\| null, text: Reading content in both input presentations; value: string \| null, text: string
仅 type=input 的输入框前后缀: Input prefix and suffix for type=input only
两种输入形态的清空节点；clear(event?: Event): void: Clear node in both input presentations; clear(event?: Event): void
clear-icon 替换整个清空节点，自定义节点需要调用 clear，并自行提: clear-icon replaces the entire clear node. A custom node must call clear and provide an accessible button. There is no default input replacement, empty or loader-error slot; option does not replace the field input.
显式 data 加载的等待统一显示在当前 Input/Textarea 字段，原: Explicit data loading appears in the current Input/Textarea field, whose native input announces aria-busy. Mention 当前仅在 Cedar 提供。Maple 没有对应运行时，本次不新: Mention currently exists only in Cedar. Maple has no counterpart runtime; this change adds no component, loading-mode or extra error menu.

Closing suggestions or making the field readonly removes active references; arrow navigation keeps DOM focus in the native input. SelectEditMode 在根入口和 select 子入口一致导出，值沿用各: SelectEditMode is exported consistently from root and select subentries, retaining each platform public edit-mode values.
原生 combobox 与独立展开按钮都声明 aria-haspopup=tre: The native combobox and separate open button both announce aria-haspopup=tree. While the panel is visible, the same aria-controls points to the actual tree. Expanded state stays synchronized; disabled/readonly and open-trigger-target rules remain in force.
手动 loading 或当前候选请求处于加载状态时，纯选择字段保留已有值，暂停新: While manual loading or the current candidate request is active, selection fields preserve existing values and pause selection, clearing and tag removal. 候选数组或 (query, { signal }) 加载函数；显式数组优先。: Candidate array or (query, { signal }) loader; explicit arrays take precedence.
同步回显回退；可返回人员对象，false 关闭未匹配回显。: Synchronous display fallback; may return a person object; false hides unmatched values.
候选缺失时的响应式回显姓名。: Reactive display name when the candidate is absent.
人员信息不可用时的默认姓名文本。: Default name text when person information is unavailable.

人员阅读内容显示聊天按钮；未提供 chat 时禁用。: Show the chat button in person reading content; disabled without chat.

显式聊天任务；返回 Promise 时仅对应按钮等待，失败发送 action-e: Explicit chat task; a returned Promise keeps that button waiting; failures emit action-error.
阅读操作区域渲染函数；actions 插槽优先。: Reading action renderer; the actions slot takes precedence.
人员阅读入口，不创建编辑字段；read 插槽与 read-pretty 使用同一: Person reading entry without an editor field; read uses the same scope as read-pretty.
统一字段纯阅读状态，省略时继承表单；不请求函数候选。: Common field reading state, inherited from the form when omitted; does not fetch function candidates.
字段编辑入口，省略时继承 FormItem / Form，否则 direct。: Field editing entry, inherited from FormItem / Form when omitted, otherwise direct.

Mutating a plain-object or Date event snapshot does not alter the parent model or later internal snapshots. Identity semantics such as Map keys follow the existing Form policy. field 支持与 FormItem 一致的点号及方括号路径。写入时自动创建缺失: field supports the same dot and bracket paths as FormItem. Writes create missing object containers and preserve sibling fields. Existing local-mirror, debounce and accepted-echo behavior for model updates and change notifications is preserved.
输入后先更新内部镜像，再通知父级。父级未接收更新时，界面仍保留本次输入；后续不同: Input updates the internal mirror before notifying the parent. If the parent does not accept the update, the input remains visible locally; a different external model replaces the mirror. `collapsed` likewise updates locally before notification and accepts later external changes. To reject an input, explicitly provide a new model object.
表单值；未传入时使用 default-value: Form values; uses default-value when omitted
仅创建时读取的初始值: Initial values read only at creation
透传 Grid 属性，优先于容器给出的同名配置: Forwarded Grid properties, taking precedence over matching container settings
change 防抖毫秒；0 立即通知，非有限数或负数回退 500: change debounce in milliseconds; 0 notifies immediately; negative or nonfinite values fall back to 500
字段属性按注册表 `defaultProps`、字段 `props`、容器管理的: Field properties merge in order: registration `defaultProps`, `field` `props`, then the container-owned `modelValue`, with later values taking precedence. `gridItemProps` passes through to GridItem. `formItemProps` can override the FormItem `field` and `label`, but does not change the schema `field` path used for model writes. `grid-props` can also override Grid settings such as `cols` and `collapsed`; avoid conflicting container state.
输入时即时同步值快照: Immediate value snapshot notification on input
输入防抖、回车即时通知；autoEmitChange=false 时由失焦或回车: Debounced input notification and immediate Enter notification; with autoEmitChange=false, blur or Enter notifies
事件仅作通知，不收集 Promise，也不驱动加载状态。: Events are notifications only; listener Promises are not collected and do not drive loading state.
操作区（搜索 / 重置等），与展开收起同一行；没有作用域参数；collapsib: Actions such as search/reset beside expand/collapse; no scoped arguments; available with collapsible=false
挂载后的内部 Form 实例，可调用 validate、clearValidat: Inner Form instance after mounting; supports Form methods such as validate, clearValidate and resetFields
`formRef` 是实例属性，不是方法。内部 Form 的 `resetFie: `formRef` is an instance property. Calling the inner Form `resetFields` restores its recorded initial values locally without emitting FilterForm `update:modelValue` or `change`. To reset the complete filter, replace the bound business model; for example:
在 `actions` 中使用 `type=\"button\"` 的搜索或重置: Use search/reset buttons with `type="button"` in `actions` and manage the model and queries in business handlers. The container exposes no additional reset/search methods or task execution entry point.
自定义校验；context 含 model/field；异步必须返回 Promi: Custom validation; context contains model/field; asynchronous rules must return a Promise
FieldRule 保留对象规则及 callback 错误通路：调用 callb: FieldRule retains object rules and callback errors: callback(message) reports business validation failure. An asynchronous rule must return a Promise; normal completion without an error callback means success. A delayed callback without a returned Promise is not awaited. Returning false or an error string does not replace callback.
意外 throw 或 Promise 拒绝会让公开 validate 拒绝，调用: Unexpected throws or Promise rejection reject public validate. Handle them with try/catch. Form 与 FormItem 的默认插槽没有作用域参数；FormItem 还提: Form and FormItem default slots have no scoped arguments. FormItem also provides label, help and extra slots without model helpers. Form manages state through the model object and field paths.
`validate(callback?)` 和 `validateField(f: `validate(callback?)` and `validateField(fields, callback?)` await their rules, returning undefined on success or an error record by field on business failure. Callbacks only notify for a current task. Errors contain field, message, label, value, type and isRequiredError. The value remains the original field value.
submit-success 先于 submit 通知，业务校验失败时 subm: submit-success precedes submit; business failure sends submit-failed before submit. An unfinished editing session sends only submit-failed. 这些事件是通知，不等待监听器 Promise，也不自动执行请求或切换 loadi: These events notify only: listener Promises are not awaited and do not execute requests or control loading. Business code manages asynchronous-save loading. Native reset prevents default behavior, resets fields and then notifies reset. Form resetFields writes to model; an inner Form inside FilterForm has its own scope.
`beforeCommit` 属于支持编辑事务的字段组件，签名为 `(paylo: `beforeCommit` belongs to fields supporting editing transactions. Its signature is `(payload, done, context) => void | boolean | Promise<void | boolean>`. The payload contains value and previousValue; context contains signal and an optional event. Returning undefined waits for done; a boolean or Promise settles by its result. It is not a Form submit event or general loading entry point.
FormRules 是按字段名组织的 FormRule 或其数组。FormRul: FormRules maps field names to a FormRule or rule array. FormRule supports functions and Zod schemas rather than Cedar FieldRule objects; unsupported structures produce development prop diagnostics. Use FormItem.required for required validation and markers rather than a decorative-only rules.required object. Functions receive `(value, context)` with model and field; candidate saves validate a candidate model. Only true passes; other normal returns become error text through String. Promises are supported. Zod uses safeParseAsync and the first issue message.
意外 throw 或 Promise 拒绝会让公开 validate 拒绝，调用: Unexpected throws or Promise rejection reject public validate for try/catch handling. The current task releases validating and retains its previous business error, without a business-failure notification. Stale exceptions do not clear newer pending feedback. FormItem validate only notifies the latest normal boolean result. Form.useValidation, Form.useForm, Form.useFormItem and FormItem.useFormItem retain their composition roles.
外部列值数组；初始化及外部变化同步候选: External column values; synchronize candidates initially and on external changes
非受控初始列值，仅创建时读取: Uncontrolled initial column values, read only at creation
内部弹层适配开关；false 为嵌入式组件: Internal popup adapter switch; false renders the embedded component
非受控初始开关，仅创建时读取: Initial uncontrolled opening, read only at creation
dynamic=true 时的挂载容器；false 保持原位: Popup container when dynamic=true; false renders in place

服务初始列值，优先于 defaultValue: Initial service values, taking precedence over defaultValue
服务挂载容器，遵守共享容器协议；false 保持原位: Service container following the shared popup-container protocol; false renders in place
change 后通知候选列值；不等于业务确认: Candidate values after change; does not imply business confirmation
滚轮保留本地候选：modelValue 作为外部同步入口，用户滚动或键盘选择会更: The wheel retains local candidates. modelValue synchronizes from outside; scrolling or keyboard selection updates candidates and notifies change followed by update:modelValue. 动态调整 optionHeight、optionCount 会重新居中并停止旧滚: Changing optionHeight or optionCount recenters candidates and stops old scrolling transitions. columnsCount immediately updates visible columns, preserving retained nodes, focus and candidates. Picker(options) 是明确的异步选择服务。服务复制配置对象并管理自己: Picker(options) is an explicit asynchronous selection service. Explicit popupContainer values are respected; the default is body. open, defaultOpen and dynamic are not service Options; component Props still support embedded and popup modes.
服务返回 PickerResolvedData，state 为 confirm、: The service returns PickerResolvedData with state confirm, cancel or close. confirm/cancel include values, indexes and options; close contains only state. Picker.close() closes only the current service singleton.
工具栏 title、cancel、confirm 插槽均无作用域参数。自定义按钮: The title, cancel and confirm toolbar slots have no scoped arguments. Custom buttons may call instance confirm()/cancel(). Picker.Component and _PickerComponent are actual SFCs; default Picker is the callable service and installation entry point.
DatePicker 与 DateRangePicker 只组合明确的面板能力和: DatePicker and DateRangePicker aggregate explicit panel capabilities and view extensions rather than all private renderer parameters. 控制当前日期高亮使用 showCurrent，选择当前按钮使用 showNowB: Use showCurrent for current-date highlighting, showNowButton for selecting now, pickerValue/defaultPickerValue for the viewport, and min/max/disabledDate for selectable-value constraints. Existing field lists, abbreviation, wheel settings, appearance and actual panel capabilities remain available. loading-icon is not wired to a public panel or date-field slot and is not an available capability.
显式字段保存守卫，使用 payload、done、context: Explicit field-save guard using payload, done and context
允许清除；不会绕过禁用、只读或等待状态: Allow clearing with disabled, readonly and pending guards
非受控初始值，仅创建时读取: Initial uncontrolled value, read only at creation
有效选择后立即提交；字段还请求关闭: Commit a valid selection immediately; fields also request closing
禁用交互；字段未设时继承 FormItem/Form: Disable interaction; fields inherit FormItem/Form when unset
返回禁用小时，小时始终为 0–23: Return disabled hours in the 0–23 clock

字段编辑模式；未设时继承 FormItem/Form: Field editing mode, inherited from FormItem/Form when unset
面板阴影等级，false 关闭: Panel elevation; false disables its shadow
清空动作的输出，不改变空值识别策略: Output of clearing; independent of empty-value recognition
空值识别列表，覆盖而不合并: Empty-value recognition list, replaced rather than merged
字段错误展示；未设时继承: Field error presentation, inherited when unset
字符串解析、显示及输出格式；十二小时缺省带 a: String parsing, display and output format; 12-hour defaults include a

手动加载反馈，不从事件返回值推导: Manual loading feedback, independent of event return values
最大可选钟点，HH:mm 或 HH:mm:ss，包含端点: Maximum inclusive clock time in HH:mm or HH:mm:ss

外部值；数值和 Date 保留原值，正常提交输出格式化字符串: External value; numbers and Dates retain their input kind, while normal commits output formatted strings
点击整个字段或仅图标打开；不限制键盘打开: Open by field or icon click, without restricting keyboard opening
移动范围字段的面板形态: Panel presentation of the mobile range field
滚轮展示配置，不能覆盖拥有者模型和规则: Wheel presentation options, excluding owner model and rules
占位文字；范围可使用起止数组: Placeholder text; ranges also accept start/end arrays
编辑层挂载容器，false 保持原位: Editor container; false renders in place

移动范围独立面板的展示方式: Presentation of the mobile standalone range panel
纯阅读展示，不渲染编辑器；独立于 readonly: Read-pretty presentation without an editor, independent of readonly
只读；字段可聚焦复制，不改值或展开编辑: Readonly; fields allow focus/copy without value changes or opening editing
范围起止之间的分隔文字，允许空串: Range separator text, including an empty string
仅范围：允许结束早于开始并显示次日，不交换起止: Ranges only: allow an earlier end time as next day without swapping endpoints
显示此刻操作，只改草稿并要求确认: Show the now action, changing only draft and requiring confirmation
五档尺寸；字段遵循表单继承: Five sizes, following field Form inheritance
以 0 点为起点的时分秒步长，无效步长回退为 1: Hour/minute/second steps from midnight; invalid steps fall back to 1
滚轮列及顺序；显式列表决定可见列，不改格式或模型: Wheel columns and order; an explicit list controls visibility without changing format or model
独立时间面板的展示配置，根拥有模型、规则和状态: Time-panel presentation options; model, rules and state remain owned by the field
范围面板展示配置，根拥有模型、规则和状态: Range-panel presentation options; model, rules and state remain owned by the field
桌面通用面板的单选/范围模式: Single/range mode of the desktop general panel
属性表的继承、按格式或有效步长说明是有效缺省，原始 Props 可为 undef: Inherited, format-derived and effective-step defaults describe resolved behavior; raw Props may be undefined. Without format, the default is HH:mm:ss, or hh:mm:ss a with use12Hours=true. Bounds use 24-hour clock times, separate from Date-family valueFormat/time-zone rules.
事件只通知，不收集监听器 Promise。update:modelValue 与: Events notify only; listener Promises are not collected. update:modelValue and change include null, 0, Date or range arrays allowed by the clearing policy. select reports formatted draft rather than saving. Field update:open/open-change are opening requests; initialization does not notify automatically.
字段 focus(index?)、blur() 作用于真实输入或触发区，不改变模: Field focus(index?)/blur() target the actual input or trigger without changing model. read receives value/text, suffix-icon receives focus/popupOpen, and clear-icon receives guarded clear(event?). prefix, selected, suffix and extra are unscoped; ranges also have separator. actions 和 extra 属于面板草稿，Cedar direct 转发；M: actions/extra belong to panel draft: Cedar direct forwards them, Maple direct does not, and deferred editing forwards them. ### 面板业务事件与草稿初始化: ### Panel business events and draft initialization
纯面板业务事件为 update:modelValue、change、select: Pure-panel business events are update:modelValue, change, select and confirm. select reports candidates; valid confirmation notifies confirm, while update:modelValue/change only occur for an actual value change. Field opening, clearing and focus events do not belong to pure panels.
draft-initialize 是 Maple 内部面板向字段拥有者暂存初次可: draft-initialize is an internal Maple bridge staging the first visible candidate for the field owner. It is not business selection/commit, emits no select/change and does not close editing. Cedar does not promise this signal. Public panel event types exclude it; business code should not depend on it.
beforeCommit(payload, done, context) 仅属于: beforeCommit(payload, done, context) belongs to field saving. payload contains value/previousValue; context has signal and optional event. Returning undefined waits for done, while boolean/Promise results settle by their result. FormItem validates candidates first; failure retains draft. Ordinary select/change/confirm/click listener returns do not use this task protocol.
面板外部值，初始化草稿并响应后续变化: Panel external value, seeding draft and accepting later changes
只读面板，不改草稿或确认: Readonly panel without draft changes or confirmation
面板 actions 的完整作用域如下；extra 无参数。: Complete panel actions scope below; extra has no arguments.
清空输出或工厂，不改变空值识别策略: Clear output or factory, independent of empty-value recognition
字段事件完整列表见本页“字段事件与插槽（完整）”。: See the complete field events and slots section on this page for all field notifications.
面板事件完整列表见本页“纯面板事件（完整）”。: See the complete pure-panel events section on this page for all panel business notifications.
参数为对应公开事件类型的元组；日期参数由格式化钟点解析，不承诺保留输入 Date: Arguments are tuples from the corresponding public event type. Date arguments are parsed from formatted clock times and do not promise to preserve an input Date calendar day.
显示与手输格式；函数只展示，无反向手输解析: Display/text-input format; a function only formats without reverse text parsing
包含上界，非法的已提供边界不会被静默忽略: Inclusive maximum; a supplied invalid boundary is not silently ignored
包含下界，非法的已提供边界不会被静默忽略: Inclusive minimum; a supplied invalid boundary is not silently ignored
Maple 字段面板形态，独立于 editMode: Maple field panel presentation, independent of editMode
Maple 日期/时间滚轮展示配置，不接管根模型与规则: Maple date/time wheel presentation options, excluding the root model/rules
Trigger 展示配置；运行时过滤根状态、模型、规则和控制监听器: Trigger presentation options, filtering owned state/model/rules/control listeners at runtime
内容拼接或起止显示的分隔文字，允许空串: Separator text for joined/range display, including an empty string
显示此刻操作；范围能力按各端实际面板定义: Show the now action according to the actual panel range capabilities
Cedar 日期内时间面板展示配置，不接管日期模型/规则: Presentation options for the Cedar embedded time panel, excluding date model/rules
日期精度；Cedar 支持周/季度，Maple 支持日期/月/年: Date precision; Cedar includes week/quarter, while Maple supports date/month/year
月份网格使用缩写，false 使用完整月份名: Use abbreviated month-grid names; false uses full month names
Maple 内部日历按钮阴影: Elevation of Maple internal calendar buttons
日期滚轮列及顺序；显式列表决定可见列: Date wheel columns and order; an explicit list controls visibility
日期面板展示选项，根拥有模型、规则和类型: Date-panel presentation options, with model/rules/type owned by the field
范围面板展示选项，根拥有模型、规则和类型: Range-panel presentation options, with model/rules/type owned by the field
每周第一天，仅日历展示，整数 0～6: First day of week for calendars, an integer from 0 to 6
初始日历视口，仅初始化读取；优先已选值，再用当前日期: Initial calendar viewport, read once; selected values take precedence over the current date
返回 true 禁用当前日期，side 为 start/end: Return true to disable the date; side is start/end
按日期与端点返回禁用小时、分钟、秒列表: Return disabled hour/minute/second lists for a date and endpoint
交互候选反序时是否连同日期交换时间；不重排模型/手输/快捷值: When interactive candidates reverse, swap times together with dates; model/text/shortcut values are not reordered
Maple 日历视口模式；不是字段编辑模式: Maple calendar viewport mode, independent of field editing mode
Maple 多选；避免同时开启范围模式: Maple multiple selection; avoid enabling range mode at the same time
受控日历视口，不是选中值；范围视口含两个日期: Controlled calendar viewport, separate from selection; range viewports contain two dates
悬停/聚焦快捷项时预览，不提交: Preview shortcuts on hover/focus without committing
Maple 通用独立面板的范围模式: Range mode of the Maple general standalone panel
快捷项；值或按需执行的同步值工厂，可含 format/disabled: Shortcuts with values or on-demand synchronous value factories, optional format/disabled
仅高亮当前日期，不改变选择或模型: Highlight the current date without changing selection or model
启用时刻精度和时间选择，可见精度由格式决定: Enable time precision/selection, with visible precision controlled by format
IANA 时区；无效时区不会回退成有效可选值: IANA time zone; an invalid zone does not fall back to a valid selectable value
Maple 摘要标题背景色，优先于 color: Maple summary-title background, taking precedence over color
Maple 日历的触摸翻页；仍受视口模式和只读约束: Maple calendar touch paging, subject to viewport mode and readonly rules
Maple scroll 视口使用虚拟渲染: Use virtual rendering for the Maple scroll viewport
序列化模型格式，支持 Date、timestamp 或格式字符串；独立于 for: Serialized model format: Date, timestamp or format tokens, independent of display format
DateValue 为 string、number 或原生 Date。数值按时间: DateValue is string, number or native Date. Numbers are timestamps and 0 is not empty; modelValue=null is explicitly empty. Ranges retain broad arrays and incomplete endpoints rather than forcing a tuple; commits still validate completeness and validity. 属性表列出实际公开集合；继承及按精度说明表示有效缺省，原始 Props 可为 u: Tables list actual public properties. min/max 包含端点；非法的已提供边界阻止确认，不静默当作未设置。动态收紧规: Bounds are inclusive. Invalid supplied bounds block confirmation instead of being treated as omitted.
