独立面板只有下表七类事件，没有旧 preview 事件；导航使用 picker-: Standalone panels have the seven events below, without the old preview event. Navigation uses picker-value-change and update:pickerValue. Navigation/shortcut hover-focus preview does not imply selection or commit. Confirmation only notifies when valid; select draft is separate from committed change.
字段值及视口通知参数使用对应公开 Emits 元组；DateChangeArgs: Field value/viewport notifications use the corresponding public Emits tuples; DateChangeArgs contains value, date(s) and text(s). Listener Promises are not awaited and do not drive loading. beforeCommit uses payload/done/context, with value/previousValue in payload and signal/optional event in context; undefined waits for done.
字段 default 可替换触发区；prefix/selected/suffix: Field default replaces the trigger; prefix/selected/suffix replace content, and ranges also support separator. Preserve names, endpoint distinctions and keyboard access when replacing native controls. read receives value/text, suffix-icon receives focus/popupOpen, and clear-icon receives guarded clear(event?), respecting emptyValue and disabled/readonly guards.
actions 的参数为 { confirm, disabled, select: actions receives confirm/disabled/selectNow/nowDisabled, with both actions returning void. It has no Time-panel canConfirm/value arguments. disabled=true prevents confirmation. Standalone panels can replace the action region; the outer editing shell owns final saving in hosted editing, while the panel contributes auxiliary actions. Panel confirm is not the outer-save method.
此刻能力按面板定义：Cedar 单值面板支持，Cedar 范围面板没有此刻入口；: Now capabilities follow the actual panel: Cedar single panels support it, while Cedar range panels have no now action. Maple range panels stage now for the active endpoint, preserve the other endpoint and still require confirmation. The presence of selectNow in scope does not imply every mode supports the action.
Cedar cell 定制日历格，参数含 date，范围另含 type=star: Cedar cell customizes a calendar cell with date and, for ranges, type=start/end; extra adds content. Maple Date/DatePicker page-calendar summaries support year({year}), month({year,month}), date({week,year,month,date}), range({choose}) and multiple({choose}) according to mode. Maple DateRange/DateRangePicker do not forward these single-panel summary slots, nor do scroll/line viewports promise them.
loading-icon 尚未接通到日期字段或纯面板，不因底层装饰器支持而列为可: loading-icon is not wired to date fields or pure panels and is not available merely because the underlying decorator supports it. Field focus(index?)/blur() delegate to real controls. Cedar/direct-field blur closes the field popup; Maple range persistent-reference blur only clears its focus, without pretending to close the outer Drawer. Pure panels expose no focus/blur methods.
datePickerProps/dateRangePickerProps 只配置: datePickerProps/dateRangePickerProps configure presentation without overriding owned model/rules/type/control events; Maple internal range datePickerProps uses a calendar allowlist. popupProps retains a broad dictionary, with public DatePopupOptions/DateRangePopupOptions recommended and owner keys still filtered at runtime. Cedar timePickerProps configures embedded time presentation; Maple pickerProps configures wheels.
范围 placeholder 字符串重复用于两端，数组分别指定起止且缺项为空；r: A range placeholder string applies to both endpoints; arrays configure each and missing entries are empty. readonly is separate from disabled; unset field state inherits Form. Cedar range-panel exchangeTime only handles reversed interactive candidates: true swaps their times, false retains endpoint times. It does not reorder external model/text/shortcut values. Maple does not expose this property.
选择后立即提交；false 保留草稿待确认: Commit on selection; false retains draft for confirmation
清空输出或同步工厂，不改变 emptyValues 识别: Clear output or synchronous factory, independent of emptyValues recognition
外部日期值；undefined 为非受控，null 为显式空值: External date value; undefined is uncontrolled, null is explicitly empty
字段占位文字，未设跟随 Locale: Field placeholder, following Locale when omitted
只读面板，不改变候选或提交: Readonly panel without candidate changes or commits
禁用整体或分别锁定起止；字段未设时继承 FormItem/Form: Disable all or lock start/end separately; fields inherit FormItem/Form when unset
范围字符串重复用于两端，数组分别指定；未设跟随 Locale: A range string applies to both endpoints, arrays configure each; omitted follows Locale
Maple 摘要提示，摘要区域显示时生效: Maple summary hint, effective when the summary region is displayed
范围内部日历展示白名单，不覆盖根所有权: Allowlisted internal range-calendar presentation, excluding owned root state
完整属性、事件、插槽及实例边界与主字段文档的独立面板章节一致。: Complete properties, events, slots and instance boundaries match the standalone-panel sections in the main field documentation.
字段与面板的完整事件分别见本页对应完整列表。: See the complete field and panel event lists on this page.
公开面板业务事件类型不包含 draft-initialize；它仅用于 Mapl: Public panel business event types exclude draft-initialize, which is an internal Maple owner bridge. Panels do not accept field beforeCommit or loading properties.
`flex` 只覆盖列宽，不移除 `offset`、`order` 或响应式配置: `flex` overrides column width while preserving `offset`, `order` and responsive configuration. `span: 0`, including breakpoint values, still hides the column; a matching nonzero span restores visibility while `flex` controls width. Removing `flex` restores the span width. Visual ordering does not change DOM or keyboard navigation `order`.
Row 的响应式 gutter 通过 JavaScript matchMedia: Row resolves responsive gutter with JavaScript matchMedia, using xs for SSR and synchronizing the viewport after mounting. Col uses CSS media queries: SSR already emits all configured classes without waiting for measurement. Breakpoints use viewport width: xs is the base; sm ≥576, md ≥768, lg ≥992, xl ≥1200 and xxl ≥1600px. Only configured fields override earlier values. Offset starts at the logical inline edge and mirrors in RTL. Order affects visual positioning while preserving DOM, keyboard and assistive technology reading order.
span、offset 及断点中的对应字段接受 0–24 整数；span=0 隐: Span, offset and their breakpoint fields accept integers from 0 through 24. A zero span hides the column; offset 24 shifts it by a full row width. Order accepts finite integers, including negative values and values above 24, subject to browser CSS order computation. Gutter accepts finite nonnegative numbers, six-breakpoint objects or exactly two entries [horizontal, vertical]. Development diagnostics report unknown breakpoints, invalid numbers and enum values. Invalid span falls back to 24; invalid offset/order is ignored; breakpoint objects retain valid fields; invalid gutter components fall back to zero.
逻辑行内起点偏移；0–24 整数，0 可恢复: Offset from the logical inline start; integer 0–24, with zero restoring it
排序；有限整数，可为负数，0 可恢复: Visual order; finite integer, including negative values; zero restores it
占用栏数；0–24 整数，0 隐藏: Column span; integer 0–24, with zero hiding the column
默认插槽参数 `{ overflow: boolean }` 表示父 Grid: The default slot receives `{ overflow: boolean }`, indicating whether the parent Grid hides ordinary items due to collapse. Every GridItem, including suffix items, reads this shared state; it does not describe that item’s own overflow. It is false when expanded. SSR and the initial pre-mount render show every item; collapse is computed after mounting, which can change the initial layout. Offset reserves space from the logical inline start and mirrors in RTL. Span counts content tracks, while offset is included separately in the track budget. There are no custom events or public methods.
逻辑行内起点留空格数: Empty tracks from the logical inline start
数值输入必须有限；保留既有有限数值的取整和归零规则：cols 向下取整且至少 1: Numeric inputs must be finite. Existing finite-value rules remain: cols is rounded down with a minimum of 1; collapsed-rows has a minimum of 1; negative gaps and offsets become zero; nonpositive spans are hidden. Non-finite or malformed inputs fall back to the property default: cols=24, collapsed-rows=1, span=1, and gaps/offset=0. Responsive objects accept only the six breakpoints and retain valid fields; undefined is omitted. Development diagnostics use standard Vue prop validation.
折叠预算按实际 DOM 顺序计算，后缀可位于开头、中间或末尾，不会为计算而移动内: Collapse budgeting follows actual DOM order. Suffix items may appear first, in the middle or last; budgeting never moves content nodes. A suffix occupies the logical end of its row, so later ordinary items may wrap. Ordinary items retain the fitting continuous prefix, while every suffix remains visible. If suffix items alone exceed the row budget, keeping them visible takes precedence over limiting total rows. Layout does not change DOM, keyboard or assistive technology reading order.
breakpoint 在挂载后订阅视口，SSR 保留 collapsed 或 d: Breakpoint subscriptions begin after mounting; SSR retains the initial collapsed or default-collapsed state. Changing the breakpoint immediately evaluates the current viewport. Removing it stops automatic responses and keeps the current collapsed state. The xs breakpoint requests collapse at widths up to 575px; other breakpoints request collapse below their minimum width, consistently collapsing on narrow screens.
初次订阅及断点配置变更时，breakpoint 通知当前窄屏状态；后续匹配状态改: The breakpoint event reports the current narrow-screen state on initial subscription and breakpoint configuration changes, then on matching-state changes, independently of collapsed. update:collapsed and collapse(..., responsive) are requested only when the target differs from the current collapsed state. Controlled mode waits for the parent to update the prop; environmental notifications still occur when the parent declines a state request. Notification events do not await promises returned by listeners.
width、height 以及更新事件的数值采用当前 box-sizing 对应: Width, height and their update event values use the CSS dimension for the current box-sizing: border-box includes borders and padding; content-box describes the content area. Measurement, keyboard/pointer deltas and writeback share the same dimension without subtracting handle padding again. Arrow keys move the corresponding edge by 10px; Shift plus an arrow moves it by 50px. Controlled mode requests a parent update and retains its current dimensions until that update occurs.
已开始的鼠标或指针拖动，在正常释放、取消、配置变化、KeepAlive 停用或卸: An accepted mouse or pointer drag produces exactly one end notification on release, cancellation, configuration changes, KeepAlive deactivation or unmounting. Listeners and cursor ownership are released before notification. ResizeBox retains moving-start/moving-end; Split retains move-start/move-end. When no native terminal mouse event exists, the end argument is the original press event. Discrete keyboard adjustments emit value updates without creating drag start/end events. Ending stops the gesture without rolling back an applied dimension or awaiting a listener’s returned promise.
提供 resize-directions 时，Sider 统一管理当前宽度：展开: When resize-directions is provided, Sider owns the current width: expanded mode retains the most recently resized width; collapsed mode uses collapsed-width and removes resize handles; expanding restores the latest expanded width. Collapse/expand preserves content nodes and input state. A collapsed-width of zero still supports the recovery trigger outside the content area. When the width prop value changes, temporary resizing is cleared and the new numeric or CSS length value takes effect. Controlled collapsed still waits for parent writeback. Transform-mode content width and translation use the latest expanded width.
自身原生滚动；需约束高度: Native scrolling on the layout; constrain its height
强制横向侧栏布局；可用于 SSR，挂载后也自动识别 Sider: Force sider layout, including SSR; mounted Sider children are also detected
内容区自身原生滚动；需约束高度: Native scrolling on the content; constrain its height
物理侧栏位置；RTL 不交换 left/right: Physical sider placement; RTL does not swap left/right
width 改可用宽度，transform 保留展开内容宽度并平移裁切: width changes available width; transform retains expanded content width and translates/clips it
侧栏主题，并提供给后代组件: Sider theme, also provided to descendants
提供时受控，等待父级回写: Controlled when provided; waits for parent writeback
显示默认折叠触发器，不禁止外部或响应式折叠: Show the default trigger; does not block external or responsive collapse
展开基准宽度；有限非负像素数或非空 CSS 宽度字符串: Expanded base width; finite nonnegative pixels or a nonempty CSS width string
折叠宽度；有限非负数，0 保留恢复入口: Collapsed width; finite nonnegative pixels, with a recovery trigger at zero
反转默认箭头；right 位置也自动反转: Reverse the default arrow; right placement also reverses it
挂载后按窄屏状态请求折叠，动态配置立即重算: Request collapse on narrow screens after mounting; re-evaluate changed configurations immediately
用 ResizeBox 替换默认 div；物理边数组，折叠时移除手柄: Use ResizeBox instead of the default div; physical edges, with handles removed while collapsed
隐藏默认触发器，调用方提供恢复入口: Hide the default trigger; the caller supplies recovery access
boolean，当前环境是否位于折叠侧，独立于受控状态: boolean; whether the environment requests collapse, independently of controlled state
作用域 { collapsed: boolean }；位于原生按钮内部，不嵌套另: Scope { collapsed: boolean }; rendered inside a native button, so do not nest another button
Layout、LayoutContent、LayoutSider 提供 scro: Layout, LayoutContent and LayoutSider expose scrollTo(options: ScrollToOptions) and scrollTo(x: number, y: number); Header/Footer have no dedicated instance methods.
开发环境使用 Vue 属性校验诊断枚举、非有限/负宽度及重复/未知伸缩边；运行时: Development uses Vue prop validation for enums, non-finite/negative widths and duplicate/unknown resize edges. Runtime filters/deduplicates edges, defaults invalid width/collapsed-width to 200/48 and placement to left, and does not subscribe to invalid breakpoints. Default trigger names use locale.layout.expandSider/collapseSider through global useLocale or ConfigProvider.locale. Public Props derive from actual components with typed event listeners; resizeDirections uses ResizeBoxDirection[].
当前盒模型的 CSS 宽度；有限非负像素数: CSS width under the current box model; finite nonnegative pixels
当前盒模型的 CSS 高度；有限非负像素数: CSS height under the current box model; finite nonnegative pixels
根 HTML 标签，需提供有效标签名称: Root HTML tag; supply a valid tag name
不重复的物理边数组；空数组移除所有手柄: Unique physical edges; an empty array removes all handles
宽度更新请求；受控模式等待父级回写: Width update request; controlled mode waits for parent writeback
高度更新请求；受控模式等待父级回写: Height update request; controlled mode waits for parent writeback
width/height 的 0 有效；无效数值不写入 CSS，按未提供尺寸处理: Zero width/height is valid. Invalid numbers are not written to CSS and behave as omitted dimensions. Invalid edge lists produce no handles; valid array edges are retained and deduplicated, with standard Vue development diagnostics. Public Props include model-update and drag-notification listeners; returned promises are not collected.
`size/default-size/min/max` 接受有限非负数字、数字字: `size/default-size/min/max` accept finite nonnegative numbers, numeric strings, and `px` or `%` strings. Unitless values from 0 to 1 are ratios; values greater than 1 are pixels. `50%` and `0.5` mean the same ratio; `1px` explicitly means one pixel. `rem`, `calc()`, negative values and nonfinite numbers are unsupported. Vue prop validation warns in development. Invalid size/default-size falls back to `0.5`, min to 0, and max to 100`%`.
尺寸按当前排列轴的容器长度计算，并限制在容器内；min 大于 max 时以 mi: Sizes use the container length along the current layout axis and stay inside the container. If min exceeds max, min wins within the container. Ratios follow container changes; pixel sizes stay unchanged while they fit. Each pane contributes half of the default 6px handle, with this adjustment clipped at the edges to prevent container overflow. Disabling removes the handle and its entire adjustment while preserving both panes and their input drafts.
面板、ARIA 和拖拽/键盘共用有效尺寸。边界或容器变化使尺寸越界时，会请求一次: Panes, ARIA, dragging and keyboard input share one effective size. When bounds or container changes make a size illegal, the component requests `update:size` once. If a controlled parent rejects it, presentation still respects the bounds and later input starts from that effective size. Controlled input within the legal range remains subject to parent acceptance. Updates are numeric ratios or px strings matching the input unit category. Ordinary notification events do not await Promises.
横向 RTL 拖动时向左增大第一个面板；纵向仍向下增大。分隔条可聚焦，左右键按屏: In horizontal RTL dragging, moving left enlarges the first panel; vertical dragging still enlarges downward. The separator is focusable. Left/Right moves it visually, or Up/Down vertically, in 10px steps or 50px with Shift. Home/End reaches min/max. Mouse and touch pointers share sizing logic. Direction/orientation changes, disabling and unmount cancel an active drag and restore the previous cursor. Legal sizes remain unchanged when orientation changes; if the new axis makes the size illegal, the component requests the effective size.
分隔手柄的可访问名称；空白时使用当前语言默认名称: Accessible name of the separator handle; blank values use the current locale default
拖拽、键盘或有效边界修正请求；用于 v-model:size: Drag, keyboard or legal-bound normalization request for v-model:size
接受拖拽后开始通知；容器没有可测尺寸时不触发: Start notification for an accepted drag; not emitted without measurable container size
有效拖拽移动通知: Notification of an active drag movement
释放或取消后的结束通知；同一次拖拽只通知一次: End notification after release or cancellation, once per accepted drag
指针拖拽参数可以是继承 MouseEvent 的 PointerEvent。没有: Pointer drags may supply a PointerEvent, which extends MouseEvent. Without a native terminal event, the end payload is the press event. Keyboard input emits only update:size. Ordinary events do not collect or await listener Promises.
默认手柄名称由现有全局语言或 ConfigProvider 提供。使用 `ari: The existing global locale or ConfigProvider supplies the default handle name. Use `aria-label` to identify a business pane, for example `aria-label="Resize navigation pane"`; it names the focusable separator handle. Custom resize-trigger or resize-trigger-icon slots retain the supplied role, range, name and keyboard behavior.
四个具名插槽均无作用域参数，组件不消费 default 插槽。SplitInst: All four named slots have no scope parameters; the component does not consume a default slot. SplitInstance is the standard Vue instance type with no extra resize command methods. Drive dimensions through props and v-model:size. SplitProps includes actual props and typed model/drag listeners, consistently exported from the root and subentry.
elevation=false 不生成阴影等级类，true 使用 2；数字先四舍: elevation=false adds no elevation class, true uses level 2, and numeric values are rounded to the nearest integer then clamped to 0–24. NaN/Infinity produce Vue prop validation warnings in development and fall back to 2 at runtime. Numeric radius/width/height values must be finite and nonnegative; invalid numbers remove that inline dimension instead of retaining its previous value, while zero remains valid. Decimal and scientific-notation numeric strings use px. Other CSS strings are parsed by the browser; expressions unsupported by the browser are not promised.
click 只通知并传递原始 MouseEvent，包含冒泡的子元素点击；@cl: click only notifies with the original MouseEvent, including bubbling clicks from children. @click.once follows standard Vue event semantics without awaiting listener Promises. PaperProps includes this listener and is consistent between root and subentry. PaperInstance has no additional business execution methods.
需要留白的物理边；[] 不补偿，不表示位置或展开方向: Physical edges receiving spacing; [] compensates none and does not represent position or expansion direction
SafeAreaEdge 是 top/right/bottom/left 的联合: SafeAreaEdge is the top/right/bottom/left union, and SafeAreaInsets maps those edges optionally to numbers. SafeAreaInstance represents a component instance without a setInsets method. setInsets is static on the component object; do not call it on a template ref.
子入口的默认组件与子入口、根入口的命名组件是同一组件。Props 类型包含实际事: The subentry default component and the named components from the subentry and root are the same component. Props includes actual listener parameters. Events remain notifications and do not await returned Promises. Use only the documented instance methods.
JS 模式只解析有限数字、十进制或科学计数法数字字符串，以及 px、rem、vw: JS mode parses only finite numbers, decimal/scientific numeric strings, and px, rem, vw, vh, vmin or vmax, including negative offsets. Unsupported JS lengths such as em, %, calc() and var() warn in development and measure as zero instead of treating a numeric prefix as pixels. CSS mode delegates to native sticky, converting numeric strings to px and leaving other valid CSS expressions to the browser. NaN/Infinity/blank values receive Vue prop validation warnings. Invalid CSS offsets are removed and JS measurement falls back to zero. target changes listeners and JS measurement, not the actual native sticky scroll ancestor or clipping boundary.
duration 必须是有限非负毫秒数；0 立即回顶。非法时长在开发环境由 Vu: duration must be finite, nonnegative milliseconds; zero scrolls immediately. Invalid durations produce Vue prop validation warnings in development and retain the immediate-completion runtime fallback. The easing presets are linear, quartOut and easeInOutCubic; invalid names warn and fall back to quartOut. A custom function receives progress from 0 to 1: finite results are clamped to 0–1, while nonfinite or nonnumeric results use the current linear progress. Promises are not awaited. Thrown errors propagate unchanged to the calling environment; that frame schedules no further animation, and scrollToTop can retry. No click success or extra error event is fabricated.
expand-trigger 仅支持 click；非法值在开发环境由 Vue 属: expand-trigger supports only click. Invalid values produce Vue prop validation warnings in development and do not enable button semantics, click or keyboard expansion. line-clamp accepts finite numbers or numeric strings of at least one row and floors decimals. Values below one, nonfinite values and invalid strings warn and fall back to ordinary single-line mode, clearing old multiline styles. Prefer plain text or inline content without independent interactions. The default Tooltip still does not detect actual overflow and remains focusable with Tab when enabled. Custom tooltip content and controlled expansion remain unchanged.
原生属性、style 和 tabindex 等应用到内层滚动视口；outer-s: Native attributes, style and tabindex apply to the inner scrolling viewport; outer-style/outer-class apply to the outer container. The outer container may be wider: tracks still align with the inner viewport and use the same length for thumb ratios instead of extending through outer blank space. Track mode reserves space outside the viewport; embed mode overlays its edges. Dual-axis corners and live axis changes remeasure while preserving content nodes and native scroll position. Track thickness reads the actual CSS size of the existing --c-scrollbar-track-size and recomputes after theme changes.
外层类名，支持字符串、布尔类名对象及数组: Outer class accepting strings, boolean class objects and arrays
Vue 样式值，包括 CSS 字符串、对象、数组和条件 false: Vue style values including CSS strings, objects, arrays and conditional false
三个属性均可省略。hide、disable-horizontal、disable: All three props are optional. hide, disable-horizontal and disable-vertical are internal composition controls omitted from public ScrollbarProps. Hiding a decorative axis does not prevent native content scrolling or public scroll commands.
内层视口原生滚动通知，保留原始 Event；不等待监听器 Promise: Native scroll notification from the inner viewport with the original Event; listener Promises are not awaited
滚动内容；提供一个根元素供内容尺寸观察: Scrolling content; provide one root element for content-size observation
支持坐标或原生选项；省略数字坐标时按 0 处理: Accept coordinates or native options; omitted numeric coordinates default to zero
设置原生纵向位置，0 有效: Set the native vertical position, including zero
设置原生横向位置，0 和原生 RTL 负值有效: Set the native horizontal position, including zero and native RTL negative values
对象选项透传原生 Element.scrollTo，可使用 left、top 和: Object options pass to native Element.scrollTo, including left, top and behavior. Animation and cancellation follow browser rules without additional JS animation or completion Promises. Retained commands do not scroll inactive or unmounted instances.
id、dir、tabindex、role、aria-label 和普通 clas: id, dir, tabindex, role, aria-label and ordinary class/style apply to the inner viewport. For keyboard scrolling, provide tabindex=0 and a readable name, then use native arrow or page keys while the viewport is focused. Interactive content retains its own focus and key behavior.
横向公开坐标采用浏览器的原生 scrollLeft，不转换为统一正数。RTL 中: Public horizontal coordinates use native browser scrollLeft without conversion to a common positive coordinate. Chromium RTL may use negative values; pass those native coordinates to scrollLeft/scrollTo. Visual thumbs stay synchronized. Internal thumb offsets are not public scroll coordinates.
有限非负数，向下取整并限制到项目总数；达到总数时全部保留，即使超出容器。非法值回: Finite nonnegative count, floored and clamped to the item total. All items remain when the minimum reaches the total, even if they overflow. Invalid values fall back to 0.
项目之间额外的逻辑间距，单位 px；保留项目自有 margin。有限非负数，非法: Extra logical gap between items in px, preserving item margins. A finite nonnegative number; invalid values fall back to 8.
折叠数据序列的起点或终点，不随 RTL 改变数据顺序。非法值回退为 end。: Collapse the start or end of the data sequence. RTL does not change data order. Invalid values fall back to end.
隐藏数量改变时通知；首次测量和重新测量可能触发。返回 Promise 不会等待。: Notifies when the hidden count changes, including initial measurement and remeasurement. Returned Promises are not awaited.
待测量的项目；每项需要一个可测量的元素根节点和稳定、唯一的 key。: Items to measure; each needs a measurable element root and a stable unique key.
折叠提示内容；number 为隐藏数量，默认显示 +number 标签。: Overflow indicator; number is the hidden count. Defaults to a +number tag.
容器需提供受约束的可用宽度。容器、可见项目大小和 min、margin、from: Provide a container with a constrained available width. Container size, visible item size, min, margin and from changes trigger measurement; same-count item replacements invalidate cached sizes by identity.
隐藏项目会卸载，重新测量时可能暂时重新挂载。请把需要保留的输入或业务状态放在外部: Hidden items unmount and may temporarily remount during remeasurement. Keep persistent input and business state externally; this is not a virtual list. Internal changes to unmounted items cannot be observed; update the key when content identity changes.
服务端先输出全部项目，客户端取得布局后折叠。直接文本不计为项目；多根组件无法可靠: SSR initially renders all items; the client folds them after measuring layout. Direct text is not an item. Components without a measurable single root keep all items visible and warn in development.
建议折叠提示保持稳定宽度；依赖 number 改变宽度的提示可能需要多轮测量和多: Prefer a stable indicator width. An indicator whose width depends on number may need multiple measurements and change notifications. The slot provides indicator content and does not create a popup menu.
两种方向都使用逻辑间距，不在外侧额外留白。项目自有 margin 会与间距相加。: Both directions use logical spacing without an extra outer gap. Item margins add to the gap. The component exposes no custom instance methods.
使用普通 `v-model`。`modelValue` 表示严格受控的当前停靠高: Use normal `v-model`. `modelValue` is the strictly controlled docked height in px. `defaultValue` initializes uncontrolled state once and later changes do not reset it. An explicit binding takes precedence; initialization does not emit `update:modelValue`. Dragging shows a temporary height. Ending notifies the candidate anchor; a refusing parent restores the effective bound anchor. `touchcancel`, deactivation, or model/anchor changes during dragging cancel without committing.
有限非负锚点，单位 px；过滤非法项并去重，空或全非法时使用默认值；不要求排序，: Finite nonnegative anchors in px. Invalid entries are filtered and duplicates removed; empty or entirely invalid arrays use defaults. Sorting is unnecessary; ties prefer the earlier supplied entry.
有限非负动画时长，单位 ms；支持数值字符串，非法值回退 300，0 关闭位移动: Finite nonnegative animation duration in ms. Numeric strings are supported; invalid values fall back to 300 and 0 disables transform animation.
用户结束拖动且候选锚点改变时通知；不保证父级接受: Notifies a changed candidate anchor on drag end; parent acceptance is not guaranteed.
自定义锚点示例通过 header 插槽提供原生“收起”和“展开”按钮，键盘 En: The custom-anchor example uses native Collapse and Expand buttons in the header slot. Enter/Space adjusts the same v-model. The default drag handle supports touch only. The panel root does not automatically declare a dialog or button role; provide region names and interaction semantics for the content.
高度与初始值必须是有限非负数；非法值按最小有效锚点展示。动态锚点会重新匹配最近值: Heights and initial values must be finite and nonnegative; invalid values display the minimum effective anchor. Dynamic anchors rematch the nearest value without writing back. External changes do not emit user commit events. Events are notifications; Promises are not awaited and do not drive loading. `content-draggable=false` preserves native content scrolling.
没有自有公开实例方法。8 个属性、2 个事件、2 个无参数插槽；PopupCon: No custom public instance methods. Eight props, two events and two unscoped slots. PopupContainer accepts HTMLElement, selectors and false; the shared type is authoritative.

内置淡入和四方向滑动在 `prefers-reduced-motion: red: Built-in fade and four-direction slide disable transitions and initial displacement under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`. Adapt custom animations to the reduced-motion preference in your application.

支持触摸、鼠标主键和宿主 Enter / Space。鼠标水波从按下位置扩散，松: Supports touch, primary mouse clicks and host Enter / Space. Mouse ripples expand from the press location and end on release or window blur. 十二小时显示与 5 小时步长组合时，步长从 24 小时制的零点计算，合法小时为: With twelve-hour display and a five-hour step, sampling starts at midnight in the 24-hour clock: 0 / 5 / 10 / 15 / 20. It does not restart at noon. 开启 FileReader / data-url 后，接受的 File 会读取为: With FileReader / data-url enabled, accepted File objects are read as data URLs. 示例支持切换深浅背景、显示状态和水印文字；font.color 在深色底使用半透: The demo toggles light/dark backgrounds, visibility and watermark text. font.color uses translucent white on dark surfaces and translucent black on light surfaces. “本地图片失败”使用无效的 data URL，触发 source=image 错: Local image failure uses an invalid data URL, emits a source=image error and falls back to FALLBACK 201 text. Activate Restore image with Enter to restore the image. Error history remains, with one watermark layer.
通过点击、Space 或 Enter 切换全屏水印。全屏层固定覆盖视口，不拦截指: Toggle the full-screen watermark with click, Space or Enter. The fixed layer covers the viewport without intercepting pointer input. 滚动时长由 `duration` 控制，CSS 动效变量不改变滚动时长。`dur: `duration` controls scroll timing independently of CSS motion variables. When `duration` is zero, positioning still waits for rendering and layout to be ready.
关闭按钮支持 Space / Enter，关闭不会同时触发选中。可选中标签支持: Close buttons support Space / Enter without selecting the tag. Selectable tags also support Space / Enter. Controlled checked is accepted by the parent; otherwise the component stores its state. Loading blocks selection.
收紧下限至 10:30:40 时，字段仍显示原值 10:30:38，但面板不能确: After tightening the minimum to 10:30:40, the field retains 10:30:38 but the panel cannot confirm it. Selecting and confirming the inclusive maximum 10:31:02 updates the model. Editing seconds to 00 and canceling keeps seconds 02.

全屏水印固定覆盖视口，不拦截指针操作；退出后回到局部容器，默认插槽内容保持原位。: The full-screen watermark covers the viewport without intercepting pointer input. Exiting returns it to the local container without moving default-slot content. Repeated toggling does not accumulate layers; unmounting removes that instance.
duration（默认 3000ms，0 持续显示）是业务展示计时，不是 CSS: duration (default 3000ms; 0 stays open) is a business display timer, not CSS animation duration. close notifies once per mounted instance and immediately cancels timers. Plain divs must provide their own interactive semantics, keyboard behavior and accessible names; v-ripple supplies none.
- `duration` 单位为毫秒，`0` 表示常驻；`Message.loa:
- `duration` is milliseconds; `0` stays open. `Message.loading(...)` stays open by default.
- Within one mount container/position, the same `id` updates the instance without duplicate DOM.
- Only `resetOnUpdate`=`true` restarts the full duration on same-id updates.
- `pauseOnHover` saves remaining time and resumes it on pointer leave.
- Display deadlines are independent of CSS motion. Restarting, hover pause, cleanup/unmount invalidate old timer callbacks, which recheck open before running.
- KeepAlive deactivation cancels timers; reactivation restarts the current full duration. Updates while deactivated/retained restart after unmount do not schedule work.
- Resuming exhausted positive hover timing requests closing; resetting duration to 0 keeps it open. Only finite positive durations auto-close; negative/nonfinite values do not schedule.
- Services await actual leave completion rather than forcing 150ms/200ms exits. Closing/clearing before mount cleans up directly and reports service onClosed without inventing component open/opened/close animation events. Business duration stays independent of CSS transitions.
- Local reduced motion cancels transitions/displacement while retaining independent-message static horizontal/center positioning, colors and display deadlines. No global tiny-duration fallback is required.
- Queues isolate by `popupContainer + position`; `Message.clear(position?)` clears per position.
- 局部减少动效取消进出过渡和动画位移，保留独立提示的水平/居中静态定位、颜色及: - Local reduced motion cancels transitions/displacement while retaining independent-message static horizontal/center positioning, colors and display deadlines. No global tiny-duration fallback is required.

只解析当前应用已注册的图标。连续切换 name 时只展示最新请求的图标，卸载后停: Only resolves icons registered in the current application. Repeated name changes display the latest requested icon, and unmounting stops pending switches.

- `duration` 单位为毫秒，`0` 表示常驻；`Message.loa:
- `duration` is milliseconds; `0` stays open. `Message.loading(...)` stays open by default.
- Within one mount container/position, the same `id` updates the instance without duplicate DOM.
- Only `resetOnUpdate`=`true` restarts the full duration on same-id updates.
- `pauseOnHover` saves remaining time and resumes it on pointer leave.
- Display deadlines are independent of CSS motion. Restarting, hover pause, cleanup/unmount invalidate old timer callbacks, which recheck open before running.
- KeepAlive deactivation cancels timers; reactivation restarts the current full duration. Updates while deactivated/retained restart after unmount do not schedule work.
- Resuming exhausted positive hover timing requests closing; resetting duration to 0 keeps it open. Only finite positive durations auto-close; negative/nonfinite values do not schedule.
- Services await actual leave completion rather than forcing 150ms/200ms exits. Closing/clearing before mount cleans up directly and reports service onClosed without inventing component open/opened/close animation events. Business duration stays independent of CSS transitions.
- Local reduced motion cancels transitions/displacement while retaining independent-message static horizontal/center positioning, colors and display deadlines. No global tiny-duration fallback is required.
- Queues isolate by `popupContainer + position`; `Message.clear(position?)` clears per position.
